feeds.title: The Diamond Store Magazine
feeds.description: TheDiamondStore.co.uk is the UK's leading, award winning online diamond jewellery retailer. We designed our website to guide you, the customer, to the most suitable jewellery for your budget without compromise and to make your special occasion memorable.

feeds.title: Voltaire Diamonds Blog
feeds.description: Voltaire Diamonds is an Irish owned company. We specialise in Engagement Rings / Wedding Rings. Find information that meets all your needs regarding diamonds.

feeds.title: All Diamond Blog
feeds.description: Features diamond jewellery, interesting facts about diamond cuts, diamond quality, jewellery manufacture, jewellery HistoryJewellery Trends & crafting techniques. AllDiamond.co.uk is a website where buyers of high-quality diamond jewellery can find the best products available from skilled gemmologists, craftspeople, and designers.

feeds.title: Serendipity Diamonds Blog
feeds.description: Explore a collection of articles on jewellery advice, diamond rings, engagement rings and jewellery news. Serendipity Diamonds is a diamond jewellery specialist, creating a wide range of diamond jewellery including engagement rings, wedding rings, and diamond pendants.

feeds.title: Diamond Dealer Direct Blog
feeds.description: Diamond Dealer Direct is an established engagement ring & wedding band specialist located in the heart of Birmingham's famous Jewellery Quarter. Follow this blog that covers topics such as engagement, jeweller, wedding, etc.

feeds.title: Ahimsa London Blog
feeds.description: Enter the glittering world of Diamonds with an informed view. Ahimsa London's blog is the ultimate guide that provides a comprehensive understanding of lab-made diamonds, making them the perfect choice for ethical jewelry. Ahimsa London is a luxury online boutique specializing in ethical diamond jewelry and bespoke design services.

feeds.title: Diamonds Hatton Garden Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on diamond engagement rings, tennis bracelets, diamond necklaces, earrings and pendants. Diamonds Hatton Garden is a wholesaler of fancy coloured and colourless diamonds and an engagement ring specialist in Hatton Garden, London.

feeds.title: Purely Diamonds Blog
feeds.description: At Purely Diamonds we have over 40 years of heritage in designing & creating beautiful diamond & gemstone jewellery. We take great pride in manufacturing exclusive items that will be loved and cherished by you for years to come.

feeds.title: Shining Diamonds Blog
feeds.description: Blog educates you on different styles of jewellery and offers romantic inspiration for important occasions, such as proposals or weddings. Also covers jewellery advice, tips, and the latest trends.

feeds.title: 77 Diamonds
feeds.description: 77 Diamonds is an Award-winning jewelry company based in Mayfair, London. Our passion for diamonds and jewellery spans more than 20 years, drawing on a heritage that goes back four generations. We are delicately crafting high-quality diamond jewellery, specializing in engagement rings.

feeds.title: Diamond Dealer Direct Blog
feeds.description: Diamond Dealer Direct established itself as a diamond wholesaler in 1972. As a longstanding supplier of fine polished diamonds to the Birmingham Jewellery Quarter, we quickly grew and began offering our services to an international market. Follow to get updates.
